_meta.indication: TALZENNA is indicated for the treatment of adult patients with deleterious or suspected deleterious germline BRCA-mutated (gBRCAm) HER2-negative locally advanced or metastatic breast cancer; select patients based on an FDA-approved companion diagnostic.

pivotal_trials.design: Open-label, randomized study (2:1) comparing talazoparib 1 mg to physician's choice therapy (capecitabine, eribulin, gemcitabine, or vinorelbine).
pivotal_trials.population: Adult patients with deleterious or suspected deleterious germline BRCA-mutated (gBRCAm) HER2-negative locally advanced or metastatic breast cancer.
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Primary endpoint was progression-free survival (PFS) assessed by blinded independent central review (BICR).
pivotal_trials.result: Median PFS 8.6 months (talazoparib) vs 5.6 months (PCT); HR 0.54 (95% CI 0.41, 0.71); p < 0.0001.

key_safety: Most common (>=20%) adverse reactions were fatigue (62%), anemia (53%), nausea (49%), neutropenia (35%), headache (33%), thrombocytopenia (27%), vomiting (25%), alopecia (25%), diarrhea (22%), and decreased appetite (21%). Grade >=3 anemia, neutropenia, and thrombocytopenia occurred in 39%, 21%, and 15% respectively. MDS/AML was reported in 2 of 584 (0.3%) solid tumor patients.
target_moa: Talazoparib is a poly (ADP-ribose) polymerase (PARP) inhibitor; PARP enzymes (particularly PARP-1 and PARP-2) facilitate DNA repair of single strand breaks, and talazoparib inhibits PARP enzymatic activity and traps PARP on DNA, preventing DNA repair.

rems.type: No REMS were required for talazoparib based on the review of this NDA.

companion_dx_detail: BRACAnalysis CDx is the FDA-approved companion diagnostic used to identify germline BRCA mutations for patient selection; 354 of the trial patients were confirmed using BRACAnalysis CDx.

advisory_committee.vote: No ODAC was convened for this application.

description.text: Added new indication for Talzenna in combination with enzalutamide for HRR gene-mutated metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer (mCRPC)

citations.quote: This Prior Approval supplemental new drug application provides for a new indication for Talzenna in combination with enzalutamide for the treatment of adult patients with homologous recombination repair (HRR) gene-mutated metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer (mCRPC).

description.text: Approved final overall survival update for the existing HRR gene-mutated mCRPC indication (talazoparib + enzalutamide); proposed expansion to HRR-unselected mCRPC was not approved

citations.quote: We have completed our review of this application. The overall survival update for the existing indication for the treatment of adult patients with HRR gene-mutated mCRPC, based on the final analysis of TALAPRO-2 is approved, effective on the date of this letter, for use as recommended in the enclosed agreed-upon labeling.

basis.text: The application was designated as a Priority review NDA.

summary.text: TALZENNA (talazoparib) NDA 211651 was submitted by Pfizer and received April 6, 2018, granted Priority review, and approved on regular (traditional) approval based on the Phase 3 EMBRACA trial demonstrating improved PFS; no advisory committee (ODAC) was convened, and no REMS was required.
